beats.text: At dawn, Ravana came to the garden, surrounded by his queens and torchbearers, with music playing.
'Marry me,' he said, 'and all of Lanka is yours.' When she refused, he roared that she had two months to change her mind.
Sita placed a blade of grass between them and refused to even look at him. 'Rama will come for me.'
Ravana stormed away. The demonesses taunted her until she was alone.
Then an old demoness, Trijata, woke up shaking. 'I dreamed that Rama came on a white elephant, and Lanka sank into the sea. Do not harm her.'
Then a gentle voice from the tree began to sing the story of Rama: Ayodhya, the exile, the golden deer, the search.
Sita looked up and saw a small monkey among the leaves, his hands folded.
